book.name: 1 KORINTA
book.title: 1 Korinta Yeisu ana totugugunayao Korinta goiadi leta vakuumgoina

content: Paulo italavaita Guyauina kámasa kerose goi manuna
Tuwo moitamo, segowo, yau boi ao yaimi Yaubada valena vamoounina ivinigu ataalavaite go, geya kada tomota idi nanamsa goi o idi katanaki goi atalavaite geya.
Moitamo. Boi bogina alovina dogoi tayamo toito yaimi goi bei atalavaiteyamo. Dogoiyana moe Yeisu Guyau be nakae ana tupatúkwana kerose goi adi yagoina. E moe atalavaitedi.
Ago boi yau magu neneta, magu matoita be magu malitatátava Yaubada matana goi tutayana akaaiyaka yaimi.
Guna livala o guna talavaita ana vala moe geya kada toinigu guna nanamsa goi atamyabimi geya, go sem Baloma Kimaasabaina ina togaga ana kamoitamo goi ataalavaita
bego imi numisa unana moe geya kada tomota idi nanamsa goi geya, go sem Yaubada ina togaga goi.
Yaubada ina nanamsa manuna

E nanamsa toina manuna moe tomota madi numisa maatuwoidi yaidi goi kataalavaita. Moe nanamsayana geya kada tuta ame ana nanamsa o tuta ame ana tolovinao idi nanamsa geya; tolovinayadi Yaubada bei ikausaolidi. Moe pasina amo nanamsayana geya katalavaiteyeta,

go sem nanamsa toinayana moe Yaubada ina nanamsa vamoounina kataalavaite. Moe ina nuwogau Natuna ina guinuwa manuna bogina ikaiwoduwe. Boi nava kaga liliuna geya imadagidita go, nuwogauyana igimilosinapuye bego ana káeyana tomoeeyalina kita bei tasiuko.

Nanamsayana geya kada tayaamo tolovina tuta ame goi iyagoi geya. Neta boi poyapoya ame ana tolovinayao siyagoi, bei ida Tomoya, Tauyana Yaubada ana káeyana ana tovagitákwana, e kerose goi geya situpatukoeta,
go sem geya siyagoiyeta nakae Gínina Kimaasabaina bogina idige kana,
‘Dogoi dedevidi Yaubada ana tomatakoiyao manudi ikatubayasidi. Amo dogoiyadi tomota geya sigitedita, geya sinovedita be nakae geya sinuwedita.’ Aiseya 64:4

E dogoiyadi Yaubada bogina ikaiwoduwedi kai yaima. Ina kaiwoduwoyana moe Balomaina goi. Bogina koyagoi. Kina Balomainayana kaga liliuna idovaatusidi. Nakae Yaubada ina nuwonúwana nikuunikudi nakae idovatusidi be iyagoidi.
Avatau tomota ina nuwonúwana iyagoi? Tomota anetava nuwona goi iyagoi ae? Yaubada ina nuwonúwana nakae; geya vatau tayaamo iyagoidi go, Yaubada Balomaina anetava iyaagoidi ae?
E kai Yaubada poyapoya nuwonuwonina geya ivinimeta geya, go sem toinina Balomaina ivinima bego itoboinema ina yabobona liliudi bogina iviniibesoima kayagoidokoidi.

Moe yabobonayadi kai nakae katalavaaitedi go, ima talavaitayana tomota idi nanamsa goi geya sivatulukoimeta, go sem Yaubada Balomaina ivatulukoima. Tuwo Baloma Kimaasabaina ina nuwonúwana kidi ina tomotao yaidi goi kataligeidi.

E kidi go sakava tomotaidi Yaubada Balomaina ina vatulúkwana sikatae. Neta sinove, sinuwonúwana geya ana yagoinamo. Nakae geya itoboinedita vatulukwanayana ana dedevina siyagoi unana Baloma Kimaasabaina ina vaita kaka goi vatulukwanayana kadovatusidoko, tauna sikatae.
E kai go Baloma Kimaasabaina ina tomotao kaga liliuna kadovatusidokoidi. Ego geya vatau tayaamo itoboine idovatusima.
Moitamo.
‘Avatauwa Yauwe nuwona siyagoi bei itoboinedi sivatuluko?’ Aiseya 40:13
Geya vatau tayaamo ae? E kai go nuwoma moe Guyau nuwona nakae.
